data.one_liner: Tools for analyzing the size and contents of Dart VM AOT snapshots.
data.what_it_does: Provides libraries and a CLI to parse VM snapshot profiling output, summarizing byte usage by library, class, package, etc. Helps identify size contributors and dependency impact in AOT builds.
use_when: You need to understand why an AOT snapshot is large
You want to compare snapshot sizes between builds
You need to estimate the impact of code changes on snapshot size
avoid_when: You are not building AOT snapshots
You need runtime profiling rather than build‑time analysis
strengths: Detailed breakdown of data and code sections
weaknesses: Only works with AOT snapshot profiling files
